title: Trail echo ring duplicates the live packet shape geometry in a second switch
evidence:
view.odin:1357 (echo block): "			#partial switch shape {
			case .Triangle:
				half := r * 0.866
				rl.DrawTriangle(
					rl.Vector2{e.x, e.y - r},
					rl.Vector2{e.x - half, e.y + r * 0.5},
					rl.Vector2{e.x + half, e.y + r * 0.5},
					eout,
				)" ... "			case:
				rl.DrawCircleV(e, r, eout)
				rl.DrawCircleV(e, r * 0.78, ebody)"; view.odin:1378 (live block): "		#partial switch shape {
		case .Triangle:
			// streaming: an equilateral triangle (apex up), outline + body like the dot
			half := r * 0.866" — the same 0.866/0.5/0.78 geometry restated. Contrast the project's one-definition precedent, wire_path.odin:671: "wire_path_point :: proc(p: ^Wire_Path, t: f32) -> (pos, tangent: rl.Vector2)" annotated "(ONE definition so riders stay on the ribbon)".
detail: The echo ring re-implements the live shape geometry in a second #partial switch. A new Packet_Shape case added to the live draw would silently render circle trails — the two blocks must be hand-synced.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared draw_packet_shape(center, r, outline, body) proc and call it from both the echo loop and the live packet draw.

title: run_motion_strip adds a third hand-copied demo setup/driver orchestration
evidence:
motion_strip.odin:59-73: "	// run setup — the SAME pieces run_demo applies (fixture + nodes + spawns
	// + session + growth + era), so the strip's sim timeline is the blessed
	// one (the T1 manifest pins it; this verb just renders it).
	state: pp.Run_State
	defer pp.run_destroy(&state)
	pp.run_init(&state, demo.seed, cat.hash, cat.balance.logic_hz)
	state.era = demo.era
	cfg := Demo_Replay{
		name = demo_name,
		use_fixture = demo.use_fixture,
		qos_fixture = demo.qos_fixture,
		growth_on = demo.growth_on,
		advance_gate_on = demo.advance_gate_on,
		session = {goal = demo.win_goal, cap_ms = demo.lose_cap_ms, health_on = demo.health_on, surge_win_pct = demo.surge_win_pct},
	}" — run.odin:293-301 has the same block: "	pp.run_init(&state, demo.seed, cat.hash, cat.balance.logic_hz)
	state.era = demo.era // 3.1: the demand era (0 = legacy — director inactive)
	cfg := Demo_Replay{" ; overlay.odin:57-61 repeats demo_apply_setup/lower_intents again.
detail: Third copy of the Demo_Replay setup (run_demo, overlay_check, run_motion_strip). A future run-setup directive added to run_demo but missed here silently renders strips off the blessed timeline; no manifest cross-check in the verb catches it.
recommended_fix: Extract a shared demo_begin(demo, cat) helper that builds Demo_Replay and applies setup; call it from run_demo, overlay_check, and run_motion_strip.
